scan_ledger_immutable
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER scan_ledger_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON scan_ledger
WHEN NEW.seq IS NOT OLD.seq
  OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id
  OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id
  OR NEW.submission_key IS NOT OLD.submission_key
  OR NEW.tier IS NOT OLD.tier
  OR NEW.entitlement_token_id IS NOT OLD.entitlement_token_id
  OR NEW.consumed_at IS NOT OLD.consumed_at
  OR NEW.prev_hash IS NOT OLD.prev_hash
  OR NEW.entry_hash IS NOT OLD.entry_hash
  OR NEW.mac IS NOT OLD.mac
  OR (NEW.answer_sheet_id IS NOT OLD.answer_sheet_id AND NEW.answer_sheet_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (OLD.synced_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.synced_at IS NOT OLD.synced_at)
  OR (OLD.server_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.server_receipt IS NOT OLD.server_receipt)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'scan_ledger rows are immutable');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instructor_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "full_name" TEXT CHECK (full_name IS NULL OR length(trim(full_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), "honorific" TEXT CHECK (honorific IS NULL OR length(honorific) <= 20), "email" TEXT CHECK (email IS NULL OR length(email) <= 254), "employee_no" TEXT CHECK (employee_no IS NULL OR length(employee_no) <= 40), "school_name" TEXT CHECK (school_name IS NULL OR length(school_name) <= 160), "school_address" TEXT CHECK (school_address IS NULL OR length(school_address) <= 240), "department" TEXT CHECK (department IS NULL OR length(department) <= 160), "logo_path" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(description) <= 1000), "units" REAL CHECK (units IS NULL OR units BETWEEN 0 AND 12), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subjects_code_active ON subjects (code COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX courses_code_active ON courses (code COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "course_id" TEXT REFERENCES courses(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "year_level" INTEGER CHECK (year_level IS NULL OR year_level BETWEEN 1 AND 6), "school_year" TEXT CHECK (school_year IS NULL OR length(school_year) <= 20), "term" TEXT CHECK (term IS NULL OR length(term) <= 40), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX sections_course ON sections (course_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sections_name_term_active ON sections (name COLLATE NOCASE, ifnull(school_year, ''), ifnull(term, '')) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "student_no" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(student_no)) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "student_no_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(student_no_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "last_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(last_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "first_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(first_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "middle_name" TEXT CHECK (middle_name IS NULL OR length(middle_name) <= 80), "suffix" TEXT CHECK (suffix IS NULL OR length(suffix) <= 10), "email" TEXT CHECK (email IS NULL OR length(email) <= 254), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX students_no_key_active ON students (student_no_key) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX students_name ON students (last_name COLLATE NOCASE, first_name COLLATE NOCASE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "section_students" ("section_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "enrolled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(section_id, student_id));
CREATE INDEX section_students_student ON section_students (student_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "examinations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "short_code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(short_code) = 8), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "subject_id" TEXT REFERENCES subjects(id), "instructor_id" TEXT REFERENCES instructor_profiles(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "exam_date" INTEGER, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (item_count IN (50, 75, 100)), "choice_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (choice_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5), "passing_percentage" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 75 CHECK (passing_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "multiple_mark_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incorrect' CHECK (multiple_mark_policy IN ('incorrect', 'zero')), "allow_negative_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "omr_preset" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard' CHECK (omr_preset IN ('lenient', 'standard', 'strict', 'custom')), "omr_thresholds" TEXT, "student_id_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (student_id_digits BETWEEN 4 AND 12), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'ready', 'closed')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "questions_used" INTEGER CHECK (questions_used IS NULL OR questions_used BETWEEN 1 AND item_count));
CREATE INDEX examinations_subject ON examinations (subject_id)
CREATE INDEX examinations_recent ON examinations (deleted_at, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "examination_sections" ("examination_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examinations(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id), PRIMARY KEY(examination_id, section_id));
CREATE INDEX examination_sections_section ON examination_sections (section_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "examination_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "examination_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examinations(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (label IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(examination_id, label));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "answer_keys" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "examination_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examination_versions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1), "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "change_note" TEXT CHECK (change_note IS NULL OR length(change_note) <= 500), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(examination_version_id, revision));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX answer_keys_one_current ON answer_keys (examination_version_id) WHERE is_current = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "answer_key_items" ("answer_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES answer_keys(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "question_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (question_no BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "correct_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (correct_mask BETWEEN 0 AND 31), "points" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (points BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "negative_points" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (negative_points BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (mode IN ('normal', 'bonus', 'dropped')), PRIMARY KEY(answer_key_id, question_no));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printed_sheets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "examination_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examinations(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "examination_version_id" TEXT REFERENCES examination_versions(id), "student_id" TEXT REFERENCES students(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "sheet_code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(sheet_code) BETWEEN 6 AND 32), "paper_size" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (paper_size IN ('a4', 'letter', 'long')), "copies" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (copies BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), "generated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX printed_sheets_exam ON printed_sheets (examination_id)
CREATE INDEX printed_sheets_student ON printed_sheets (student_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "examination_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examinations(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('single', 'batch')), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER, "captures_attempted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (captures_attempted >= 0), "captures_rejected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (captures_rejected >= 0), "sheets_finalized" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sheets_finalized >= 0), "device_model" TEXT, "app_version" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX scan_sessions_exam ON scan_sessions (examination_id, started_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "answer_sheets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "examination_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES examinations(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "examination_version_id" TEXT REFERENCES examination_versions(id), "scan_session_id" TEXT REFERENCES scan_sessions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "printed_sheet_id" TEXT REFERENCES printed_sheets(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "student_id" TEXT REFERENCES students(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "detected_student_no" TEXT CHECK (detected_student_no IS NULL OR length(detected_student_no) <= 30), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('needs_review', 'finalized', 'rejected', 'superseded')), "submission_key" TEXT CHECK (submission_key IS NULL OR length(submission_key) = 64), "image_path" TEXT, "rectified_image_path" TEXT, "omr_engine_version" TEXT, "omr_payload" TEXT, "quality_score" REAL CHECK (quality_score IS NULL OR quality_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "flagged_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (flagged_count >= 0), "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finalized_at" INTEGER, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(status <> 'finalized' OR(submission_key IS NOT NULL AND finalized_at IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX answer_sheets_one_final ON answer_sheets (submission_key) WHERE status = 'finalized'
CREATE INDEX answer_sheets_exam_status ON answer_sheets (examination_id, status)
CREATE INDEX answer_sheets_student ON answer_sheets (student_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_answers" ("answer_sheet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES answer_sheets(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "question_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (question_no BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "detected_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (detected_state IN ('answered', 'blank', 'multiple', 'uncertain')), "detected_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (detected_mask BETWEEN 0 AND 31), "bubble_scores" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "final_mask" INTEGER CHECK (final_mask IS NULL OR final_mask BETWEEN 0 AND 31 OR final_mask = 32), "resolved_by" TEXT CHECK (resolved_by IS NULL OR resolved_by IN ('engine', 'instructor')), "review_note" TEXT CHECK (review_note IS NULL OR length(review_note) <= 300), PRIMARY KEY(answer_sheet_id, question_no));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "examination_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "answer_sheet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES answer_sheets(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "answer_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES answer_keys(id), "correct_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (correct_count >= 0), "incorrect_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (incorrect_count >= 0), "blank_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blank_count >= 0), "multiple_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (multiple_count >= 0), "earned_points" REAL NOT NULL, "possible_points" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (possible_points >= 0), "percentage" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (percentage <= 100), "passed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "graded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(answer_sheet_id, answer_key_id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX examination_results_one_current ON examination_results (answer_sheet_id) WHERE is_current = 1
CREATE INDEX examination_results_key ON examination_results (answer_key_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subscription_entitlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "token" TEXT NOT NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('free', 'premium')), "free_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (free_limit >= 0), "free_used" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (free_used >= 0), "lease" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (lease >= 0), "premium_until" INTEGER, "verified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offline_until" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "token_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subscription_entitlements_one_current ON subscription_entitlements (is_current) WHERE is_current = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan_ledger" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "account_id" TEXT, "submission_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(submission_key) = 64), "answer_sheet_id" TEXT REFERENCES answer_sheets(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('free', 'premium')), "entitlement_token_id" TEXT, "consumed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prev_hash) = 64), "entry_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(entry_hash) = 64), "mac" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(mac) = 64), "synced_at" INTEGER, "server_receipt" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX scan_ledger_unsynced ON scan_ledger (synced_at, seq)
CREATE TRIGGER scan_ledger_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON scan_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'scan_ledger is append-only');END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_ledger_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON scan_ledger WHEN NEW.seq IS NOT OLD.seq OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.submission_key IS NOT OLD.submission_key OR NEW.tier IS NOT OLD.tier OR NEW.entitlement_token_id IS NOT OLD.entitlement_token_id OR NEW.consumed_at IS NOT OLD.consumed_at OR NEW.prev_hash IS NOT OLD.prev_hash OR NEW.entry_hash IS NOT OLD.entry_hash OR NEW.mac IS NOT OLD.mac OR(NEW.answer_sheet_id IS NOT OLD.answer_sheet_id AND NEW.answer_sheet_id IS NOT NULL)OR(OLD.synced_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.synced_at IS NOT OLD.synced_at)OR(OLD.server_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.server_receipt IS NOT OLD.server_receipt)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'scan_ledger rows are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor IN ('instructor', 'system')), "event" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(event) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(entity_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "entity_id" TEXT, "examination_id" TEXT, "details" TEXT, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prev_hash) = 64), "entry_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(entry_hash) = 64));
CREATE INDEX audit_logs_exam ON audit_logs (examination_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX audit_logs_entity ON audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE TRIGGER audit_logs_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_logs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit_logs is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_logs_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_logs BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit_logs is append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "application_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length("key") BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "value" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(value) <= 10000), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('local_export', 'cloud_upload', 'restore')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'failed')), "file_name" TEXT, "remote_ref" TEXT, "size_bytes" INTEGER CHECK (size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes >= 0), "sha256" TEXT CHECK (sha256 IS NULL OR length(sha256) = 64), "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version >= 1), "encrypted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "error_message" TEXT CHECK (error_message IS NULL OR length(error_message) <= 500), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX backup_records_started ON backup_records (started_at)
